rows.note: Use 原諒 as the all-purpose everyday verb for pardoning a person or an offence.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 jyun4 loeng6 nei5

rows.note: Use 免除 for formally waiving a debt or payment rather than pardoning a person or offence.

example.english: The school decided to forgive the registration fee for this event.
example.traditional: 校方決定免除今次活動嘅報名費
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 kyut3 ding6 min5 ceoi4 gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 ge3 bou3 ming4 fai3

rows.note: Use 包容 when accepting or overlooking a flaw in someone or something.

example.english: You have to forgive him for being so careless.
example.traditional: 佢咁粗心，你都要包容下佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 cou1 sam1 nei5 dou1 jiu3 baau1 jung4 haa5 keoi5

rows.note: Use 彌補 when a good feature makes up for or offsets a defect.

example.english: Their enthusiasm makes up for their lack of experience, which we can forgive.
example.traditional: 佢嘅熱誠彌補咗經驗不足。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 jit6 sing4 mei4 bou2 zo2 ging1 jim6 bat1 zuk1
